subject: Re: Status: compression curves ahead of the 4/17 gate
body:
Team,

Rollout recommendation is settled, three days ahead of the 5/15 gate:

1. Tiered compression ships: 4x on dense layers, 2x on embedding tables, exactly per Yusuf's curves. Zeke's capacity model says that frees the equivalent of ~140 serving hosts across the three flagship models.
2. Human ratings from Emeka's annotation UI backed the automated story - raters preferred the uncompressed model in only 51.8% of side-by-side comparisons, statistically a coin flip. The UI itself has held up well with the vendor rater pool; we will keep it running for future compression pushes.
3. The TF1-session model is deferred to Q3. Not worth the wiring cost this window.

Deshawn - please write up the smoothed-compression schedule as the recommended default in the library docs before we socialize this more widely.

Zofia
